Menu.Name: Compendium JSON Importer
Menu.Label: Open the importer
Menu.Hint: Import actors and items from a .json, .db or .pdf file into a compendium.

Target.Label: Target compendium
Target.Exists: A compendium named {name} already exists in this world ({id}). Choose another name, or import into it.

Options.Title: Options
Options.OverwriteHint: Delete existing documents with the same name (and type) before importing.
Options.StripIdsHint: Give every document, embedded document and activity a new identifier. Uncheck to keep the identifiers of the file.
Options.EnrichHint: Fill the empty activities and the legendary data from the description. Values already in the file are never changed.
Options.UseCompendiumsHint: Items, spells and features of actors are taken from the compendiums when they exist there, then adjusted to the file. Requires the option above.

Summary.Title: Review before importing into
Summary.Updated: Of which updated to the dnd5e 6 format: {count}
Summary.ConflictsTitle: Identifiers already used in this compendium
Summary.ConflictsHint: Check the documents to import, then choose what to do with them. Unchecked documents are ignored.

Warning.DocType: The file declares documents of type {file}, but the compendium contains {pack} documents.

Notify.Done: Import into {target} finished: {created} created, {replaced} replaced, {ignored} ignored, {rejected} rejected.

Error.NotGM: Only a Game Master can import documents.
Error.PackType: The compendium {pack} does not contain {type} documents. Choose another compendium or another import type.
Error.Restored: Overwritten documents were put back: {names}. Cause: {message}
Error.Lost: Overwritten documents were deleted and could NOT be restored: {names}. Cause: {message}
Error.Skipped: Some documents were not created (refused by a hook); the overwritten ones were put back: {names}
Error.SkippedLost: Some documents were not created (refused by a hook) and the overwritten ones could NOT be put back: {names}
Error.AnalysisFailed: The analysis failed: {message}. Check the console (F12) for details.
Error.ImportFailed: The import failed: {message}. Check the console (F12) for details.

Format.empty: The file is empty. Choose a file that contains documents.
Format.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON. Check that it was exported as .json or .db.
Format.invalidLine: Line {line} of the file is not valid JSON. Fix or remove that line.
Format.noDocuments: The file contains no document. Expected a list, or an object with entries, documents, items or data.

Error.NoTarget: No target compendium. Pass a compendium (pack) or a newPackSpec in the options.
Error.BadAnalysis: The analysis is not valid. Pass the result of the analyze function.
Error.AnalysisType: The analysis holds {analysis} documents but the target compendium holds {pack} documents. Analyze the file again for this compendium.
Error.DuplicateIds: Several documents of the file share the same _id: {ids}. Check "Remove _id" or give each document a unique _id.

Pdf.scanned: This PDF contains no text (scanned PDF?). Nothing was imported.
Pdf.encrypted: This PDF is protected by a password. Remove the protection, then import again.
Pdf.invalid: This file is not a readable PDF: {message}
Pdf.readerUnavailable: The PDF reader of Foundry is not available (pdf.js missing or too old). Check the console (F12).
Pdf.parserMissing: Importing a PDF requires the active module "dnd5e-text-parser" (compatible version).
Pdf.tooLarge: This PDF is {size} MB, above the limit of {limit} MB (setting "PDF: maximum file size"). Nothing was imported.
Pdf.tooManyPages: This PDF has {pages} pages, above the limit of {limit} (setting "PDF: maximum number of pages"). Nothing was imported.

Reason.MissingType: The document has no type. Add a type such as one of: character, npc, weapon, spell.
Reason.MissingTypeNested: The embedded item {name} has no type.
Reason.UnknownType: Unknown type "{type}" for dnd5e. Known types: {known}.
Reason.UnknownTypeNested: The embedded item {name} has an unknown type "{type}". Known types: {known}.
Reason.InvalidField: Invalid value in {path}: {message}. Correct this value in the file.
Reason.Invalid: The data does not match the dnd5e 6 model: {message}. Fix the document in the file to match the model.
Reason.Unreadable: The data cannot be read: {message}. Check that the entry is a complete Foundry document.
Reason.ReplacedValue: The value {value} in {path} is invalid and would have been replaced by a default. Fix the value in the file.
Reason.UnknownActivityType: Activity {name} of {item} has an unknown type "{type}". Known types: {known}. Fix or remove the activity.
Reason.DroppedFields: {count} fields not supported by dnd5e 6: {paths}. Remove these fields from the file, or export the document again from dnd5e 6.
Reason.PackExists: A compendium named {name} already exists. Choose another name.
Reason.PackLocked: The compendium {name} is locked. Unlock it first.
Reason.InvalidName: The compendium name is empty or invalid. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
Reason.MissingLabel: Enter a label for the new compendium.
Reason.PackNotFound: The compendium {name} no longer exists. Choose another target compendium.
Reason.InvalidPackType: "{type}" is not a document type a compendium can hold. Choose Actor or Item.
Reason.MigrationFailed: The automatic update to dnd5e 6 failed: {message}. Fix this document in the file, then import again.
Reason.NotAnObject: This entry is not a document (it must be a JSON object). Remove it from the file or fix it.

Enrich.Title: Completion from the text
Enrich.Reverted: Imported without enrichment, which was refused: {reason}
Enrich.NotFound: Not found in the compendiums, built from the text:
Enrich.Ambiguous: Several matches in the same compendium, not used:

Field.attackActivity: Attack activity added from the text, bonus

Enrich.LegendaryResistanceReplaced: Legendary Resistance: the legendary action is replaced by a special activation.
Enrich.SpellLevelUnknown: Level of the spell {name} unknown: to be set by hand.
Enrich.Spellcasting: Spellcasting: ability {ability}, DC {dc}, attack {attack}, caster level {level}

Sources.Title: Compendium sources
Sources.MenuHint: Compendiums searched for the items of imported actors, and their priority order.
Sources.Hint: The first compendium of the list that contains an item decides. Uncheck the compendiums to ignore.

Pdf.Title: PDF read
Pdf.BlocksAi: (of which read by the local AI: {count})
Pdf.IgnoredItems: {count} magic items ignored: run the import again with an Item compendium to get them.
Pdf.IgnoredActors: {count} creatures ignored: run the import again with an Actor compendium to get them.

Reason.noTitle: No title found above the stat block: the creature was not imported.
Reason.missingStats: The block could not be read whole (missing: {missing}): the creature was not imported.
Reason.noEntries: No trait or action found in the block: the creature was not imported.
Reason.fontUnknown: The fonts of the page cannot be told apart: the block could not be read.
Reason.countMismatch: {acLines} Armor Class lines on the page but {blocks} stat blocks found: a block may be missing.
Reason.aiRejected: The local AI gave values that are not in the text ({fields}): the creature was not imported.
Reason.aiUnreachable: The local AI could not be reached: the block was not read.
Reason.aiTimeout: The local AI did not answer in time: the block was not read.
Reason.itemNoTitle: A magic item header without a title above it: the item was not imported.
Reason.aiPartial: Some values given by the local AI were not in the text and were ignored ({fields}).
Reason.blockCut: The stat block stops at the bottom of page {page} and its continuation was not found on the next page: the creature may be incomplete (check its last actions).

pdfAi.Name: PDF: local AI for unreadable stat blocks
pdfAi.Hint: When a stat block of a PDF cannot be read by the layout rules, send its text to the Ollama server configured below (local by default). The answer is checked against the text and marked "read by AI" in the review. Off by default.

ollamaUrl.Name: PDF: Ollama address
ollamaUrl.Hint: Base URL of the local Ollama server. Empty: the address of item-configurator when that module is active, else http://localhost:11434.

ollamaModel.Name: PDF: Ollama model
ollamaModel.Hint: Name of the model to use. Empty: the model of item-configurator when that module is active, else llama3.1:8b.

aiTimeout.Name: PDF: AI timeout per block (seconds)
aiTimeout.Hint: Time allowed to the local model for one stat block (10 to 600 seconds). Two unanswered blocks in a row stop the AI for the rest of the file.

pdfMaxSizeMb.Name: PDF: maximum file size (MB)
pdfMaxSizeMb.Hint: A larger PDF is refused before being read. 0 for no limit.

pdfMaxPages.Name: PDF: maximum number of pages
pdfMaxPages.Hint: A PDF with more pages is refused once opened. 0 for no limit.
